scope: Proposition 10.2 (Preserving arbitrary exceptional twists) of the manuscript “Metric descent and rank-preserving contractions” (preprints/Metric-descent-and-rank-preserving-contractions-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 068 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 35f14f53ac82dc8a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 57. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let π : Z → X, g : Z → Y be a smooth equivariant resolution of a dominant T-invariant rational map to a smooth projective Y , with dim Y > 0 and geometrically integral generic fibre F over K = C(Y ). Suppose that H0(F, aπ∗L|F )T ̸= 0 for some a > 0, and that dimK H0 (F, (bπ∗ L + A)|F )T ≤ 1 for every integer b ≥ 0 and every effective invariant π-exceptional integral divisor A. Then either a positive multiple of L has a nonzero invariant section on X, or a dominant rational map Y 99K Y2 to a smooth projective base of smaller dimension preserves both the generic section and this bound for every exceptional twist on a smooth equivariant resolution of the composite map.
